segments.t: The day goes on, and Vika remembers something she forgot: the money for the caviar that the restaurant needs for tonight. She gives it to Barinov, who has other ideas for it. Listen out for the little words.
Вот наличные деньги на свежую икру.
Не переживай, всё под моим контролем.
И что там с нашей плитой?
Я всегда держу своё мужское слово.
Let's see how it's put together.

'Thank you very much, my dear Vika.' The way to express 'huge thank-you' is how they say "thanks a lot". The way to express 'dear' also means "expensive". Barinov pours on the charm.

'Excellent, I will meet the courier myself.' This word means "I will meet", used for someone who arrives. The speaker uses 'courier' has an ending showing he is the one being met. Barinov's offer is a little too eager.

'Please give him the money right away.' This word means "give over", the polite "hand it over", and the next word is "to him". They express 'right away' by is also here. Vika is careful, as she always is.

'The craftsmen are already finishing the complex repair.' This word means "are finishing", the ongoing form of the action word. Notice the part 'complex' also means "difficult". The last word means any repair.

'I rely on your honesty, chef.' The phrase meaning "hope on" is used here for "rely on". This In Russian, 'honesty' translates grows from In Russian, 'honest' translates. It's a trust he does not deserve.

Barinov has the money and gives his word. It will not be spent on caviar. See you soon.
